title: Scientology flies Sheehan to Florida to court him as Hubbard's lawyer

tellings.quote: And so uh they flew me down to uh to Florida uh and the big blue cube they've got down there, this big huge blue building.

plain: In the 1970s the Church of Scientology flew the lawyer Dan Sheehan to Clearwater, Florida, to court him as a lawyer for its founder, L. Ron Hubbard. Sheehan tells Michels this happened to him, and remembers being taken to "the big blue cube they've got down there, this big huge blue building." He names the Guardian's Office, a branch of the church, as part of the story, which shows the church trying hard to recruit him.
